#| label: setup
#| echo: false


import base64

import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from IPython.display import display

try:
    pio.kaleido.scope.mathjax = None
except Exception:
    pass

if not hasattr(go.Figure, "_show_origine"):
    go.Figure._show_origine = go.Figure.show

def _show_multi(self, *args, **kwargs):
    html = self.to_html(full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False,
                        config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})
    sorties = {"text/html": html}
    try:
        pdf = self.to_image(format="pdf", width=900,
                            height=self.layout.height or 450)
        sorties["application/pdf"] = base64.b64encode(pdf).decode()
    except Exception:
        # Sans kaleido une note remplace la figure dans le PDF
        sorties["text/markdown"] = "*Figure interactive disponible dans la version HTML.*"
    display(sorties, raw=True)

go.Figure.show = _show_multi


from plotly.offline import get_plotlyjs
display({"text/html": "<script>window.__define_sauve = window.define; window.define = undefined;</script>"
                      "<script type=\"text/javascript\">" + get_plotlyjs() + "</script>"
                      "<script>window.define = window.__define_sauve;</script>",
         # sortie vide pour le PDF (sinon « Unable to display output… »)
         "text/markdown": ""},
        raw=True)

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
# Charte graphique ENSTA : bleu ENSTA, corail, bleu nuit, bleu ENSTA clair
COULEURS = ["#3746ff", "#ff808b", "#190f3c", "#9ba2ff"]
CORAIL_FONCE = "#d6455a"
